question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(3)
solution:
The correct answer is '**suffering**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that bipolar disorder typically manifests its first manic or depressed episode in adolescence or the early stages of adulthood. 
 
• The appropriate **noun **should indicate something that represents harm or distress to the forest and its ecosystem.
 
• "**Suffering**" **(****कष्ट****)** fits well as it denotes a state of undergoing pain, distress, or hardship, which aligns with the context of the harm caused by forest fires.
 
• Other options ("**blunder**", "**caressing**", "**chaos**") do not fit the context of describing the impact of forest fires on forests and biodiversity.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The meanings of the other options are given below in the table:
 
 
• **Blunder (भूल):** "Blunder" means a careless or stupid mistake.
 
• **Caressing (सहलाना): **"Caressing" means touching or stroking gently.
 
• **Chaos (अराजकता): **"Chaos" means complete disorder and confusion.
